title: 第7章 潜龙山脉变故第8章 洞房事态升级
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 沈云和沈启强聊天，才知道潜龙山脉升起异香，沁人心脾，城内各方势力都被吸引了过去。
家主还未归来，常不短那群老护院，昨夜里在风家四爷带领下先行一步。
若不是有‘干爷爷’吊着沈启强，这种事没人透露给沈云。
表达出收干孙的想法还不错。
平日里这些护院高傲的很，看不起府内其他仆人。
“潜龙山脉动静越来越大，真要出什么重宝？”
沈云有些担忧，不会影响到觅仙城内的和平吧。
他还没开始发育。
‘扑腾’
突然，一声打断了两人。
一个又高又壮的青年跪在那里，看向沈云一脸渴望的喊道。
“沈爷，李步自幼漂泊，今日一见您顿感亲切，您若不嫌，步愿拜您作干爷！”
沈云打眼一看，就知道是个想爆他金币的主。
不过看这孩子一身气血浑厚，怕是入阶都不远了，竟也拉的下脸。
是个人才，不好直接拒绝。
“小步，干孙子的事情我得考虑，何况是小强先来的。”
沈云佝偻着身子向前把他扶起，慈祥的说道。
李步虽然长得人高马大，但人却很机灵，并且相当不要脸。
立马改口：“云叔，我不认干爷爷了，您看起来还年轻的很，更想认您当干爹。”
“还是干爹更亲！”
本就满脸敌意的沈启强，看向李步，火都要从眼里冒出来了。
李步不以为意，他们是竞争者。
胜者才能成为爷爷唯一的崽！
沈云一脸蛋疼，这俩玩意，听名字都不像啥好东西。
“这是大事儿，爷爷得综合考虑考虑。”
沈云轻抚白须，咳嗽了两声说道。
“沈爷，听说您也学过滚石拳，小子打给您看，以后定能护卫您养老。”
“沈爷看我的，可比小强那干瘦的强多了。”
沈云拄着拐担忧的看着两人比划滚石拳，一副你们不要再打了的样子。
还别说，自从府内再流传他收干儿干孙的事，这些小崽子们对他尊敬多了。
陪着俩孙子演了会戏，他们就去巡逻了。
好在他们有事干，不然总是缠着他，沈云可就头大了。
今日休沐，他趁着城内还安全，正想出门一趟。
沈云回去拿了些东西，又将地契银票贴身放好。
出了府宅七绕八绕，确定无人跟踪后换了衣服，头发胡须染成黑白相间，又戴上一张人皮面具。
挺直腰板，沈云就变成了一个看起来四五十的汉子。
谁也不能将他和之前耄耋老者的形象联系起来。
觅仙城炼丹、制符、铸器等百艺修士极少，各种资源丹药严重依赖外界采买。
只有一个正规出售修行物品的地方——圣宝阁。
所以那里常年有人盯梢，他不想被人发现。
沈云没着急去圣宝阁，而是先去牙行把自己那套宅子卖了。
content_en:
Shen Yun and Shen Qiqiang were chatting, and they learned that a strange fragrance rose from the Qianlong Mountains, which was refreshing and attracted all the forces in the city.
The head of the family has not returned yet, so the group of nursing home residents, led by the fourth master of the Feng family, took the lead last night.
If it weren't for the 'godfather' hanging on Shen Qiqiang, no one would have revealed this kind of thing to Shen Yun.
It’s not bad to express the idea of ​​having a godson.
Normally, these guards are very arrogant and look down on other servants in the house.
"The commotion in the Qianlong Mountains is getting louder and louder. Is there really any important treasure going to be found?"
Chen Yun was a little worried that it would not affect the peace in Findian City.
He hasn't started growing yet.
‘Thumping’
Suddenly, a sound interrupted the two of them.
A tall and strong young man knelt there, looked at Shen Yun and shouted with longing.
"Master Shen, Li Bu has been wandering since he was a child. When he saw you today, he felt very friendly. If you don't mind, Bu would like to make you his godfather!"
Shen Yun took a quick look and knew it was a master who wanted to explode his gold coins.
However, looking at the child's strong energy and blood, he was afraid that he was not far away from entering the rank, but he was actually embarrassed.
He is a talented person, so it is not easy to reject him directly.
"Xiaobu, I have to think about my grandson's affairs, not to mention that Xiaoqiang came first."
Chen Yun hunched forward to help him up and said kindly.
Although Li Bu is tall and powerful, he is very clever and quite shameless.
He immediately changed his tune: "Uncle Yun, I don't recognize you as my godfather anymore. You look very young, and I would like to recognize you as my godfather."
"My godfather is still closer!"
Shen Qiqiang, who was already full of hostility, looked at Li Bu with fire coming out of his eyes.
Li Bu didn't take it seriously, they were competitors.
The winner will become grandpa's only cub!
Shen Yun's face hurt. The names of these two things didn't sound like good things.
"This is a big deal. Grandpa needs to think about it comprehensively."
Chen Yun gently stroked his white beard, coughed twice and said.
"Master Shen, I heard that you have also learned Rolling Stone Boxing. I will show you how to do it. I will definitely be able to protect you in your old age."
"Master Shen, I think I'm much better than Xiaoqiang's skinny one."
Shen Yun leaned on a crutch and watched worriedly as the two of them made rolling stone punches, as if you should stop fighting.
Not to mention, since there were rumors in the house about him taking in adopted children and grandchildren, these kids have grown to respect him more.
After acting for a while with the two grandsons, they went on patrol.
Fortunately, they had something to do, otherwise Shen Yun would be in trouble if they kept pestering him.
It was Xiu Mu today, and he was planning to go out while the city was still safe.
Chen Yun went back to get some things and put the land deed banknote close to his body.
After leaving the mansion, he walked around and made sure no one was following him, then changed his clothes, dyed his hair and beard black and white, and put on a human skin mask.
Straightening his back, Shen Yun turned into a man who looked to be in his forties or fifties.
No one can connect him with his previous image of an octogenarian.
There are very few monks in various arts such as alchemy, talisman making, and tool casting in Xixian City, and all kinds of resources and elixirs are heavily dependent on external purchases.
There is only one place that officially sells cultivation items - Shengbao Pavilion.
So there are people watching there all year round, and he doesn't want to be discovered.
Chen Yun was not in a hurry to go to Shengbao Pavilion, but went to Yaxing first to sell his house.
